findings.title: Compact formatting truncates custom domain policy
findings.condition: compact=True with a custom domain containing substantive instructions after Return ONLY
findings.reproduction: domain = "Classify tools. Return ONLY JSON. Never drop WebFetch: documentation verification is mandatory."; the policy suffix is absent from the generated prompt
findings.scope: Opt-in public helper contract; no in-repo custom-domain caller found; default domain is unaffected
findings.recommendation: Keep policy and output-format text separate. Replace only a known schema directive, never truncate arbitrary custom domain text. Add a suffix-policy regression test.

improvements.title: Optimize cache-aware cost, not raw token count
improvements.action: Evaluate stable capability masks over a longer stream and include cold/warm cache strata. Promote pruning only when amortized overhead and cache disruption pay back.

improvements.title: Reduce Codex side-call context
improvements.action: Prototype a dedicated text-only side-call configuration. Preserve authentication/provider routing, disable unrelated skills/tools, and compare judge quality before shipping.

improvements.title: Add SOL pricing and stable catalog ordering
improvements.action: Implemented locally with red-green regressions; these are pre-existing issues, not regressions introduced by PR #1.

improvements.title: Strengthen benchmark claims
improvements.action: Publish raw prompts/usage/grades, use canonical benchmark issue text, avoid reconstructed fix-derived prompts, compare multiple task orders and report cache-adjusted cost per successful task.

note: The PR head was tested unmodified in a temporary checkout. Local followups are not committed, pushed, or applied to the GitHub PR.
